content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I hope you're doing well. I have a [product_name] ([article_no]) and I'm trying to connect a Raspberry Pi 5 to it at my production site. My goal is to remotely modify the PLC's program from home, as well as extract its data and send it to my Raspberry Pi 5 for visualization with tools like Grafana or Power BI. To do this, I need two things: the IP address of the PLC (which I already have) and the communication port used by the [product_name] software and PLC (which I haven't been able to find). I've checked manuals and datasheets but couldn't locate any information about this communication port. I'm hoping to use the Raspberry Pi 5 as a communication gateway due to its flexibility. Thank you for any advice or information you can provide.

analysis.insight_summary: A user is trying to use a Raspberry Pi 5 to remotely access and update the program of a [product_name] ([article_no]) in a production environment, collect its data, and visualize it through platforms like Grafana or Power BI. The main challenge is finding accurate documentation regarding the communication port utilized between the [product_name] software and the PLC, as this detail is missing from available manuals and datasheets. This lack of information is preventing the user from setting up the desired remote connection.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is looking for clear and detailed documentation specifying the communication port required for connecting the [product_name] software to the PLC. They are seeking a straightforward solution for identifying the technical details needed for enabling remote programming and data collection.
